propositions: No current bug record contains detected_by metadata, preventing calculation of true escaped-defect rate or detection-stage efficiency; caused_by links are advisory proxies with demonstrated false-positive risk from blame attribution.

Plan-review first-pass is 49.0% with p90 attempts of 8 and 114.72 LLM calls per accepted completion-PASS; review-before-claim adoption rose from 29.2% to 79.5% Q2-to-Q3, indicating process maturation but mixing causal effects with gate changes.

Completion first-pass is 72.3% overall, 79.7% for tickets with Testing headings, and 74.2% with declared file impact; Testing headings and file-impact declarations correlate with better outcomes but represent textual proxies rather than causal drivers.

Source diff median size decreased Q2-to-Q3 (111.5 to 95 lines) while test co-change increased (84.5 to 160.5 lines), and ticket/DCO/Change-Id governance adoption reached >99% in latest weeks, supporting process discipline improvement.

Thirty-five modules are at or above 720 LOC with 15 at or above 780 LOC; same-file retouch is 47.7% of consecutive pairs, and 4.09% duplication exists; these are debt pressure indicators but require intersection with churn and defect history for prioritization.

Code-review first-pass is 97.4%; caused_by-linked source tickets had higher median churn (912 vs 256 lines) and lower initial plan PASS (30.3% vs 49.5%), but small-N and selection effects apply; Gerrit reviewer/vote independence was not audited.
